title: KimiWork launches AI tool with 200K token limit and 300 #kimiwork #aibreakthrough #evmarket
description:
A Chinese lab launched KimiWork, an AI-powered tool that gained over 90 million users overnight and impressed Elon Musk. KimiWork offers a 200,000 token limit, can process over 50 files simultaneously, and runs 300 agents in parallel, outperforming leading AI models in developer rankings.

KimiWork automates complex tasks like researching 100 EV companies to produce a detailed 60-page report and a 14-page presentation in just 20 minutes, consolidating data from diverse sources like Yahoo Finance, World Bank, IMF, Google Scholar, and RC. It also created websites and pitch decks for 30 local businesses within 30 minutes, delivering results traditionally requiring multiple tools and days of manual labor.

By providing enterprise-level AI capabilities for free, KimiWork challenges existing paid services like Cloud, Gemini, and ChatGPT, signaling a significant shift toward accessible, high-capacity AI solutions. This innovation could reshape workflows across research, marketing, and business development industries worldwide.
